description: Luw.ai Video AI (Motion): animate a design image into a short cinematic video — fly-throughs, dolly moves, drone shots, reveals. Camera motions: A Forward Dolly, Flythrough Cinematic, Return to Empty Room, Lighting and Color Details, Drone flying to center, Dramatic Zoom Out, Reverse Zoom In, Slow Pull Back, Reveal Zoom, Ground to Sky Tilt, Side Tracking Zoom, Aerial Descent. Pass end_image to make the video end on that frame, e.g. the original photo as image and its redesign as end_image for a before → after transition. Takes a few minutes — expect a processing_url to collect with luw_get_result. Costs 20 credits (symphony, the default) or 10 (aria), with or without end_image.

camera_motion.description: One of the camera motions listed above, e.g. "Flythrough Cinematic".

end_image.description: Optional end frame the video moves to; use the start frame's aspect ratio (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

engine.description: Luw.ai model: symphony (Symphony-3, the default: the higher quality) or aria (quicker, for everyday work). If the user picked a model earlier in this conversation, use that one.

image.description: Start frame (a render or photo) (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

prompt.description: What should happen in the video.

name: luw_generate_video
title: Image to cinematic video (Video AI)
